result.summary: Overall the page renders cleanly, but there is one clear visual defect: overlapping metadata text under the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, where the delivery time and delivery fee are rendered on top of each other, producing garbled text.

issues.description: Under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar', the metadata line reads '25–3€0 delivery' — the delivery time ('25–35 min') and delivery fee ('€0 delivery') labels overlap each other, making both unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Lay out the metadata items in a horizontal flex/stack with proper spacing and separators (e.g., '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen') instead of absolutely positioned/overlapping text elements.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows '€0 delivery' as a badge on the image, and the same fee also appears (overlapped) in the metadata line, which is redundant duplication.
issues.suggestion: Show the free-delivery info once — either as the image badge or in the metadata row — to avoid duplicated information once the overlap bug is fixed.
